name: ApiVault
tagline: Secure management and vault infrastructure for private API tokens and secrets.
overview: ApiVault provides production-grade centralized storage for API keys, bearer tokens, and secrets with rotation policies and request telemetry tracking.
features: Encrypted at-rest API key and credential persistence
Granular permission scopes and token rotation
Latency and usage quota analytics across external endpoints
Eliminates hardcoded API secrets in frontend or source control
requirements: Node.js 18+ or Docker, PostgreSQL / SQLite backend
installation:
git clone https://github.com/exa-studio/ApiVault.git
cd ApiVault
npm install
npm run build && npm start
security_notes: Always deploy behind an HTTPS reverse proxy and restrict external database port exposure.

name: API Anything
tagline: Turn arbitrary websites and dynamic SPAs into clean structured JSON endpoints.
overview: Universal scraping and network parsing bridge that monitors browser network payloads and converts web targets into self-healing REST APIs without official API keys.
features: Automatic extraction of internal fetch/XHR endpoints
Headless DOM-to-JSON fallback for dynamic single-page applications
Normalized JSON payload output with pagination detection
Self-healing schema extraction resilient to minor HTML redesigns
requirements: Python 3.10+ / Node runtime, Playwright / Chromium drivers
installation:
git clone https://github.com/goodnight000/api-anything.git
cd api-anything
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
security_notes: Avoid scraping target sites with aggressive Cloudflare Turnstile without authorized residential proxy rotation.

name: Reverse API Engineer
tagline: AI agent that drives browser traffic capture and generates production API clients.
overview: Autonomous agent that visits web targets via browser, captures network traffic to HAR, and uses LLMs to write typed API clients in Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java.
features: Dual modes: manual browser drive or autonomous AI agent capture
Chrome MCP and Playwright driver support preserving active sessions
Direct code generation in Python, JS, Go, Rust, and C#
Automated structured data collection into JSON and CSV
requirements: Python 3.10+, uv or pip, Claude Code / Anthropic SDK key
installation:
uv tool install reverse-api-engineer
# Or via pip:
pip install reverse-api-engineer
reverse-api-engineer
security_notes: Verify auto-generated client code locally before deploying to automated pipelines.

name: API Reverse Engineer (Chrome Extension)
tagline: Tab-scoped Chrome extension to intercept fetch & XHR requests into JSONL.
overview: Developer extension allowing one-click recording of internal HTTP requests while browsing normally, exporting full headers, cookies, payloads, and timing.
features: Intercepts fetch and XHR calls with zero DevTools clutter
Tab-scoped isolation preventing noisy background tab logs
Secret redaction mode masking cookies and bearer tokens prior to export
Direct JSON-Lines (JSONL) export with live request counter badge
installation:
git clone https://github.com/ctala/api-reverse-engineer.git
# Open chrome://extensions -> Toggle 'Developer mode'
# Click 'Load unpacked' and select the cloned directory
security_notes: Redaction mode should be kept enabled when recording sensitive sessions.

name: OmniVoice (K2-FSA)
tagline: Universal neural text-to-speech engine supporting multi-speaker streaming synthesis.
overview: Open-source state-of-the-art TTS engine from the K2-FSA team, optimized for low-latency edge synthesis, high naturalness, and diverse acoustic characteristics.
features: Streaming text-to-speech with chunked generation
Multi-speaker voice latent embedding support
Optimized for ONNX runtime and PyTorch inference pipelines
Highly accurate phoneme and prosody control
installation:
git clone https://github.com/k2-fsa/OmniVoice.git
cd OmniVoice
pip install -r requirements.txt
security_notes: Verify model weights checksum before loading into memory.

name: HeyGen Developer Suite
tagline: SDK and workflow connectors for AI avatar synthesis and video dubbing pipelines.
overview: Community and developer integrations bridging programmatic video avatar generation, voice synchronization, and multilingual video localization.
features: Programmatic avatar generation triggers via webhook payloads
Synchronized lip-sync alignment with input audio files
Multilingual translation and automated voice replacement flows
requirements: Python 3.10+ or Node 18+, Valid Service Account Token
installation:
git clone https://github.com/heygen-comP
# Follow specific sub-repository README instructions for credentials setup
security_notes: Upstream repo or profile may be private or restricted; check accessibility on GitHub.

name: Handy Desktop Engine
tagline: Free-form autonomous speech-to-text and keyboard macro orchestrator.
overview: A keyboard-first productivity utility combining local speech recognition with system automation, command execution, and macro dispatching.
features: Local audio transcription using lightweight Whisper backends
Global system hotkey triggers and command bar interface
Zero external telemetry or cloud audio transfer when run locally
requirements: Go 1.21+ / Python, PortAudio, Local Audio Capture Device
installation:
git clone https://github.com/cjpais/handy.git
cd handy
go build -o handy main.go
./handy
security_notes: Grant OS microphone and accessibility permissions locally on the host device.

name: OmniVoice Studio
tagline: Modern web dashboard and studio interface for the OmniVoice TTS model.
overview: Web-based graphical frontend allowing audio creators to adjust pitch, speed, speaker IDs, preview waveform buffers, and export audio in lossy/lossless formats.
features: Interactive audio timeline and pitch curve tuning
Multi-language selector and instant audio playback buffer
Batch text file synthesis and ZIP download packaging
requirements: Python 3.10+, Gradio / Streamlit or Flask, OmniVoice dependencies
installation:
git clone https://github.com/debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio.git
cd OmniVoice-Studio
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
security_notes: Restrict concurrent thread limits when generating long text on CPU targets.

name: Playlist Synchronizer
tagline: High-speed cross-platform playlist aggregator and metadata exporter.
overview: Utility dedicated to batch parsing, extracting, and syncing tracklists from YouTube, Spotify, and streaming providers with lossless metadata tags.
features: Rapid concurrent metadata scraping for multi-hundred track lists
ID3 tag injection including album art, artist, and release dates
M3U8 and JSON playlist format exports
installation:
git clone https://github.com/techgptx/Playlist.git
cd Playlist
pip install -r requirements.txt
python playlist.py
security_notes: Respect rate-limiting thresholds to avoid temporary IP throttles.

name: MAGIX Music Maker Quickstart
tagline: Modular automation scripts, templates, and track setups for DAW workflows.
overview: Template collection and automation starter kit designed to streamline soundpool organization, MIDI routing, and track setups in MAGIX Music Maker.
features: Pre-configured routing schemas for virtual synthesizers and plugins
Automated soundpool cataloging scripts
Reference guide for project stems and sample rate alignment

# Review setup guides in the repository docs folder

name: Maigret
tagline: Collect a dossier on a person by username across 3000+ public platforms.
overview: High-powered OSINT framework based on Sherlock with extended parsing capabilities, avatar extraction, web archives verification, and graph visualization.
features: Scans across 3000+ social sites, forums, and developer platforms
Generates comprehensive HTML, PDF, and Graphviz visual reports
Extracts connected profiles, country, bio tags, and linked websites
installation:
pip3 install maigret
# Or from source:
git clone https://github.com/soxoj/maigret.git
cd maigret
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
./maigret.py <username> --html
security_notes: Authorized usage only: strictly intended for security research, identity theft defense, and authorized assessments.

name: Recon-ng
tagline: Full-featured reconnaissance framework with modular plugins and database.
overview: A modular web reconnaissance framework structured similarly to Metasploit, providing automated target discovery, DNS enumeration, contact harvesting, and database reporting.
features: Extensible module architecture (discovery, exploitation, reporting)
Integrated SQLite workspace database managing contacts and hosts
Built-in interactive command-line interface with tab completion
installation:
git clone https://github.com/lanmaster53/recon-ng.git
cd recon-ng
pip install -r REQUIREMENTS
./recon-ng
security_notes: Ensure you have permission to query OSINT databases regarding the target domain.

name: Sherlock
tagline: Hunt down social media accounts by username across hundreds of networks.
overview: The standard open-source investigative utility for matching user handles across hundreds of online websites with multi-threading and proxy support.
features: High-concurrency asynchronous username lookups
Tor and HTTP/SOCKS proxy rotation capabilities
CSV and JSON output generation
installation:
git clone https://github.com/sherlock-project/sherlock.git
cd sherlock
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 sherlock <username>
security_notes: For authorized research and digital footprint auditing only.

name: Godseye 1.0 (Geospatial OSINT)
tagline: Interactive 3D geospatial OSINT globe with live aircraft, CCTV, & satellites.
overview: Tactical HUD 3D globe visualization powered by CesiumJS, integrating real-time aircraft tracks, orbital satellites, public CCTV points, seismic alerts, and weather matrices.
features: Fullscreen CesiumJS globe with HUD overlays and multiple visual modes (NVG, FLIR)
Live ADS-B aircraft data feeds, satellite orbital propagation via TLE
Integrated NASA EONET alerts, USGS earthquakes, and municipal feeds
Keyless frontend-first architecture with Bring-Your-Own-Key model
installation:
git clone https://github.com/VrushankPatel/godseye.git
cd godseye
npm install
npm run dev
security_notes: Feeds use publicly broadcast telemetry; verify local legal jurisdiction for surveillance displays.

name: APK Reverse
tagline: Android application package reverse-engineering and security auditor.
overview: Static analysis pipeline parsing Android APK packages, inspecting AndroidManifest.xml permissions, decompiling smali code, and scanning for hardcoded secrets.
features: Automated extraction of APK components, activities, and exported services
Smali decompilation and string pattern regex matching
Security vulnerability detection for insecure cleartext network traffic
installation:
git clone https://github.com/newliver666/apk-reverse.git
cd apk-reverse
pip install -r requirements.txt
python audit.py sample.apk
security_notes: Execute analysis only on applications you own or have explicit written permission to audit.

name: Image Upload Exploits
tagline: Reference test payloads for testing web application media processing parsers.
overview: A curated research repository containing safe test media files and proof-of-concept formats (SVG, GIF, PDF) for validating parser security (ImageMagick, Ghostscript) during authorized penetration tests.
features: Documentation on parser memory leaks, XXE via SVG, and SSRF vectors
Verified test cases for fuzzing media handling infrastructure
Guidance on defensive file validation, re-encoding, and MIME filtering
installation:
git clone https://github.com/barrracud4/image-upload-exploits.git
# Review defensive documentation and inspect safe payloads
security_notes: Intended strictly for authorized bug bounty programs and defensive remediation. Never upload to unauthorized third-party platforms.

name: THC Hydra
tagline: Very fast network logon cracker supporting numerous communication protocols.
overview: The industry standard security auditing tool for testing credential resilience and password policies across SSH, FTP, HTTP POST, MySQL, and 50+ network protocols.
features: Parallelized multithreaded network authentication engine
Flexible target definition and protocol fuzzing options
SSL/TLS wrapper integration for modern encrypted endpoints
requirements: Linux / BSD / Termux / macOS, GCC, OpenSSL, libssh
installation:
# On Debian/Ubuntu/Termux:
apt update && apt install hydra
# Or build from source:
git clone https://github.com/vanhauser-thc/thc-hydra.git
cd thc-hydra && ./configure && make && sudo make install
security_notes: Strictly prohibited against systems without written mutual engagement authorization.
